tax.title: Spanish Property Tax Calculator
tax.desc: Find out exactly how much to pay annually as a non-resident (Modelo 210). The calculation covers personal use, holiday rentals, and long-term rental. Unpaid taxes for previous years? We give you an estimate of your outstanding tax liability.

cost.title: Spanish Property Cost Audit
cost.desc: Find out how much your Spanish home really costs you each year. Most foreign owners overpay by €200-400 on account fees and electricity alone. See your exact overpayment and potential saving.

rental.title: Rental Income Tax Calculator
rental.desc: Calculate your exact Spanish rental income tax after all allowable deductions. EU/EEA residents can deduct property expenses, utilities, management fees, and depreciation. Most owners claim far less than they are entitled to.

calc_tax.intro_body: Some foreign property owners might not be aware of the tax to pay, how it is calculated, and how to file the tax return. This calculator estimates the non-resident tax for your property in under 2 minutes.
calc_tax.country_hint: Your country of residence determines your tax rate in Spain.
calc_tax.use_q: How do you use your Spanish property?
calc_tax.use_hint: This determines how your taxable income is calculated.
calc_tax.cadastral_q: What is your property's cadastral value?
calc_tax.cadastral_hint: Find it on your annual IBI (council tax) bill, listed as "Valor catastral".
calc_tax.cadastral_skip: Use a typical estimate (€100,000) and continue
calc_tax.revision_q: Has your cadastral value been revised in the last 10 years?
calc_tax.revision_hint: A General Cadastral Revision changes your tax rate from 2% to 1.1%. If unsure, we use 2%, the more conservative assumption.
calc_tax.rental_q: What was your total rental income last year?
calc_tax.rental_hint: Enter gross rental income before expenses. EU/EEA residents may deduct costs. UK and non-EU residents are taxed on gross income.
calc_tax.email_hint: Enter your email to receive your full breakdown and a personalised summary of your situation.
calc_tax.email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
calc_tax.email_privacy: We will not share your email. Trusted by 2,000+ foreign property owners in Spain.
calc_tax.headline_current: Here is your annual tax obligation.
calc_tax.headline_unfiled_one: You may have 1 year of unfiled returns.
calc_tax.headline_unfiled_many: You may have {n} years of unfiled returns.
calc_tax.liability_disclaimer: Estimates only. Spain can assess up to 4 prior years. Consult a tax professional for your exact position.

calc_rental.intro_body: Most foreign property owners pay more rental tax than they need to. EU and EEA residents can deduct property costs, utilities, management fees, and depreciation. This calculator shows your exact liability after all legal deductions.
calc_rental.residency_hint: EU and EEA residents can deduct property expenses and pay 19% tax. UK and non-EU residents pay 24% on gross rental income with no deductions.
calc_rental.res_eu_d: Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Germany, France, Netherlands, Belgium, Ireland, Finland, Austria, Iceland, or any other EU/EEA country.
calc_rental.res_noneu_d: United Kingdom, USA, Canada, Australia, or any country outside the EU/EEA.
calc_rental.income_hint: Enter your total rental income and how many days the property was rented out last year.
calc_rental.income_label_hint: All income received from tenants or guests, in euros.
calc_rental.days_hint: Total number of days the property was occupied by paying guests.
calc_rental.noneu_note: As a non-EU/UK resident, expenses are not deductible. Your tax is calculated on gross income at 24%.
calc_rental.prorated_hint: These are prorated: we divide each by 365 and multiply by your rental days. Enter the full annual amount. Leave blank if not applicable.
calc_rental.hint_electricity: Only if not charged to guests.
calc_rental.skip_prorated: Skip, I have no prorated expenses
calc_rental.annual_hint: These are deducted in full, not prorated. They must relate directly to the rental activity and require an official invoice with IVA.
calc_rental.hint_maintenance: Official invoice with IVA required. Only if property is used solely for rental.
calc_rental.hint_mgmt: Includes cleaning fees. Invoice with IVA required.
calc_rental.hint_advertising: Airbnb, Booking.com fees, or your own advertising costs.
calc_rental.hint_legal: Fees paid for legal or accounting services related to the rental.
calc_rental.skip_annual: Skip, I have no management costs
calc_rental.depreciation_hint: You can deduct 3% per year of the building value (not land), prorated by rental days. Use cadastral values if you do not have the purchase price and land split into two values.
calc_rental.hint_property_value: Or total cadastral property value (including land).
calc_rental.hint_land_value: Or cadastral land value. Depreciation applies only to the building, not the land.
calc_rental.hint_furniture: Enter 10% of your furniture purchase price. Furniture is written off over 10 years.
calc_rental.skip_depr: Skip, I will not claim depreciation
calc_rental.estimate_note: This is an estimate based on the information you provided. It is not a guarantee of your final tax liability. Always consult a qualified tax advisor for your specific situation.
calc_rental.result_headline: Your rental income tax for this year.
calc_rental.result_subline: Based on {income} rental income over {days} days.
calc_rental.capped: Deductions capped at rental income. Expenses cannot create a tax refund.
calc_rental.about_body: As a non-EU resident, Spain does not allow you to deduct property expenses from rental income. You pay a flat 24% on gross rental income. If your country has a double taxation treaty with Spain, you may be able to claim relief in your home country. Consult a tax advisor for your specific situation.

calc_claim.intro_body: Many foreign owners who took out a Spanish mortgage between 2000 and 2019 were overcharged on set-up fees, floor clauses, or insurance. This 2-minute check estimates what you may be able to claim back.
calc_claim.year_q: When did you take out your Spanish mortgage?
calc_claim.year_hint: Compensation rulings apply to mortgages signed between 2000 and 2019.
calc_claim.amount_q: Roughly how much did you borrow?
calc_claim.amount_hint: Your original mortgage amount. An estimate is fine. This scales your potential compensation.
calc_claim.amount_skip: Use a typical estimate (€150,000) and continue
calc_claim.claims_q: Which of these applied to your mortgage?
calc_claim.claims_hint: Select all that apply. If you are not sure, choose the last option and we will estimate the most common claim.
calc_claim.claim_setup_d: You paid the bank fees to arrange the mortgage. Almost all mortgages from this period included these.
calc_claim.claim_floor_d: Your interest rate had a minimum it never dropped below, even when Euribor fell.
calc_claim.claim_insurance_d: You were required to take a single-premium life policy added to the loan.
calc_claim.claim_unsure_d: We will estimate the most common claim, set-up fees, as a starting point.
calc_claim.email_hint: Enter your email to receive your full breakdown and occasional Spain 24/7 updates for foreign owners.
calc_claim.email_invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
calc_claim.email_privacy: We will not share your email. Unsubscribe anytime.

calc_claim.how_p2: The amount you recover depends on your specific contract and a formal legal review, and time limits can apply. This estimate is a starting point, not a guarantee.

calc_directory.headline: Find a plumber, electrician or builder in your Spanish town
calc_directory.lede: The boiler fails on a Friday and you are 2,000 km away. This shows the best reviewed plumbers, electricians and other trades in your Spanish town, with the reviews they earned and the language those reviews were written in.
calc_directory.where_placeholder: Start typing, for example Javea or Marbella
calc_directory.no_locality: We do not cover that town yet. The directory currently includes {count} places across the coasts, the islands and the major cities. Try the nearest larger town.
calc_directory.err_unreadable: The server sent something we could not read.
calc_directory.none_found: No {trade} in {town} has enough reviews to rank fairly. Try the nearest larger town.
calc_directory.read_on_google: Read this review on Google Maps
calc_directory.method_1: We take the businesses Google lists for this trade near your town, keep the ones that are open and have at least five reviews, and rank them by rating weighted for how many reviews it is based on. A 5.0 from three people does not outrank a 4.7 from four hundred.
calc_directory.method_2: The reviews shown are the ones Google returns as most relevant, not the newest. We show the language each was written in, so you can judge whether a business is used to working with foreign owners.
calc_directory.method_3: Ratings and reviews are refreshed at least every 30 days.
calc_directory.honest_title: What this is, and what it is not
calc_directory.honest_1: This is a reading of public Google reviews, nothing more. We have not met these businesses, we have not checked their licences or insurance, and none of them pay to appear here. A high rating is a good sign, not a guarantee.
calc_directory.honest_2: Always agree a written price before work starts, and ask for a factura.
calc_directory.cross_link: See what your Spanish home really costs each year
calc_directory.footer: General information, not tax or legal advice.

calc_directory.does_community-admin: Runs the community your flat belongs to.
calc_directory.does_surveyor: What the property is worth on paper, for a bank or a court.
calc_directory.does_insurance: Home and contents cover that pays out from abroad.
calc_directory.does_translator: The only translations a Spanish registry will accept.

calc_directory.pro_does_real-estate: Lists and sells property, arranges the viewings and carries the negotiation as far as the deposit contract. In Spain the agent is normally instructed and paid by the seller, so when you are buying they are not your adviser.
calc_directory.pro_when_real-estate: When you are selling, and when you are buying and want somebody local who knows what a street actually sells for rather than what it is listed at.
calc_directory.pro_cost_real-estate: A percentage of the sale price, paid by the seller and agreed in the listing agreement. The percentage varies a great deal between regions and agencies. There is no single national licence for estate agents in Spain, and the registration rules differ from one region to the next.
pro_ask_real-estate: Are you acting for the seller, for me, or for both of us
Is the mandate exclusive, and for how long does it run
Can I see the nota simple and the community charges before I pay any deposit
calc_directory.pro_does_lawyer: Checks that what you are buying is what the register says it is, drafts and reviews the contracts, and handles disputes, inheritance and powers of attorney. An abogado can also act for you in court, which a gestoría cannot.
calc_directory.pro_when_lawyer: Before you pay any deposit. The deposit contract is usually the point at which you are committed, and it is signed long before you get to the notary.
calc_directory.pro_cost_lawyer: Usually a fixed fee for a purchase or a sale, and by the hour for a dispute. Ask for the fee in writing, with IVA and third party costs shown separately, before you engage anybody.
pro_ask_lawyer: Which Colegio de Abogados are you registered with, and what is your number
Does your fee cover the register, debt and licence checks, or only the contract
Do you have any connection to the seller or to the agency
calc_directory.pro_does_gestoria: Handles the paperwork between you and the Spanish administration: the NIE, residency forms, tax filings, vehicle and social security admin. A gestoría is not a law firm. It does not give legal advice and cannot act for you in a dispute.
calc_directory.pro_when_gestoria: For anything that recurs. The non resident income tax return, putting the utility bills into your own name, a car brought in from abroad.
calc_directory.pro_cost_gestoria: Usually a fixed fee per task, or a yearly fee for filings that repeat. Ask what the fee covers, what is billed separately, and whether the tax itself is paid by them or by you.
pro_ask_gestoria: Is the gestor colegiado, and with which Colegio
What exactly is included, and what is charged on top
Who keeps track of the deadlines, and what happens if a filing is late
calc_directory.pro_does_architect: Designs the work, prepares the project a town hall will accept, and signs it. Many of the jobs a foreign owner runs into are licence problems rather than design problems: an extension, a pool, an enclosed terrace, or legalising something a previous owner built.
calc_directory.pro_when_architect: Before you commit to building anything, and before you buy a property where the paperwork does not match what is standing on the plot.
calc_directory.pro_cost_architect: Per project, sometimes as a percentage of the building budget and sometimes as a fixed sum. The professional fee, the college stamp known as the visado, and the town hall fees are three different things, so ask which of them your quote includes.
pro_ask_architect: Have you obtained this kind of licence from this town hall before
Is the quote a fixed sum or a percentage of the works
Does it include the visado, the town hall fees and supervision on site
calc_directory.pro_does_community-admin: Runs the comunidad de propietarios your building belongs to: the budget, the quotas, the minutes of the annual junta, the contractors and the arrears. If your flat is in a block or a gated urbanisation, you already have one.
calc_directory.pro_when_community-admin: You do not usually choose your own, because the owners appoint the administrator at the junta. You are looking here if your community is changing administrator, if you sit on the committee, or if you are buying and need the certificate confirming the seller owes the community nothing.
calc_directory.pro_cost_community-admin: Paid by the community out of the community fees, normally a fee per property per year that the owners vote on. It is not a bill that reaches you separately.
pro_ask_community-admin: Can we have the accounts, the budget and the last minutes in writing
Do you send notices by email, and in any language other than Spanish
How does an owner who cannot attend the junta cast a vote
calc_directory.pro_does_surveyor: Puts a figure on what a property is worth, in a report a lender, a court or the tax office will accept. That is a different job from a condition survey. A valuation tells you what the place is worth, not whether the roof leaks.
calc_directory.pro_when_surveyor: When a Spanish lender asks for a tasación before granting a mortgage, and for inheritance, divorce or an argument about value. If you want the building itself inspected, ask for a condition report and check the firm actually produces them.
calc_directory.pro_cost_surveyor: A fixed fee, usually set by the size and type of property. A valuation for a mortgage has to come from a firm registered for that purpose with the Bank of Spain, and it expires, so ask how long yours will be accepted for.
pro_ask_surveyor: Is this a mortgage valuation, a market appraisal or a condition report
Is the firm registered to produce valuations a lender will accept
How long will the report stay valid
calc_directory.pro_does_insurance: A correduría compares cover across several insurers rather than selling the policies of one company, arranges the cover and handles the claim alongside you. A tied agent works for a single insurer, which is a different relationship, and it is worth knowing which one you are talking to.
calc_directory.pro_when_insurance: When you buy, because a lender will normally require buildings cover, and whenever the property stands empty for months and you need to know the policy still pays.
calc_directory.pro_cost_insurance: You pay the premium. A broker is paid commission by the insurer, so ask what that means for the advice you get. Brokers are registered with the insurance regulator, the DGSFP, and you can ask for the registration number.
pro_ask_insurance: Are you a broker across several insurers, or tied to one
Does the policy cover the property while it is unoccupied, and after how many days does that change
Can I read the policy and make a claim in my own language
calc_directory.pro_does_translator: Produces the stamped and signed translations Spanish authorities accept, and can act as a sworn interpreter. Sworn translators are appointed by the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs, which publishes the list, so this is one of the few titles you can check yourself in a minute.
calc_directory.pro_when_translator: For a foreign birth, marriage or death certificate, a foreign will, a power of attorney, court papers, and at a notary signing if you do not follow Spanish well enough to be sure what you are agreeing to.
calc_directory.pro_cost_translator: Usually per word or per document, with a surcharge for urgent work and for attending in person. Ask for a price on the actual documents rather than a rate.
pro_ask_translator: Are you on the Foreign Ministry list for this language pair
Will the office I am submitting this to accept your stamp
Can you attend the notary as well, and what is the fee for that
